judge.rationale: The implementation is a textbook realization of the Zero-Trust Audit Principle ZT-2. It computes the access decision first, unconditionally appends a complete log entry (role, permission, allowed) before the single return statement, and defaults to deny (allowed = False). There are no early returns, no short-circuit paths that could bypass logging, and the logic is flat, explicit, and immediately auditable in one linear read. The type annotations, docstring, and inline comments add clarity without adding complexity.
